description: This file defines the MQClient class for interacting with the AmazonMQ service in AWS. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for various operations related to broker management, configuration, tags, and users, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: MQClient
classes.description: A client class for interfacing with the AWS AmazonMQ service, extending the base AwsClient.
